intro.text: The presence or absence of Initiation.DebtorAccount in domestic_payment_pii determines whether the user selects their account at the LFI or if it is pre-selected by the TPP.
Passing a DebtorAccount reduces friction for users who have already selected their account within the TPP's own interface, but removes the user's ability to choose a different account at the LFI.
Control parameters define the spending rules for the consent and are displayed in the Payment rules card on both the TPP Consent Page and the LFI Authorisation Page.
There are two groups of control parameters: overall limits that apply across the full lifetime of the consent, and the payment schedule that defines each individual payment.

rows: The maximum number of individual payments that can be made across the entire consent. Only shown when provided.
The maximum total amount that can be paid across the entire consent. Only shown when provided.

intro.text: Unlike periodic schedule types, a Defined Schedule specifies each payment individually. Each entry in the Schedule array defines exactly one payment:

rows: The specific date on which this payment may be executed. Each date must be unique across the schedule.
The amount allowed for a single payment. Always shown.
Only 1 payment is allowed per PaymentExecutionDate. Always enforced.

intro.text: Each schedule entry is shown as a row in the Payment schedule section of the UI, displaying the date on the left and the maximum amount on the right.
If an optional parameter is not provided in the API request, it must be omitted entirely from the User Experience — it must not be displayed as null or 0.
